steps.content:
<size=55>Incoming! 
The Slacking Ducks!</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa, that's amazing... We just got inside the book like that? You know what, this place is actually pretty cool.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's not a book. This is a <color=#fb9259>Hologram</color>.
A round and chubby Hella is talking to the equally round and chubby Hecate next to her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: These are our virtual avatars, like the one Nino uses.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: And everything here is just a projection. They've got nothing to do with our original world.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh...? So you're saying I can do whatever I want here without consequences?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Theoretically speaking, yes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then it's decided! I'm going to defeat the strongest enemy in this world of projection!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's an admirable goal, but we should deal with our current situation first.
The two look around to find themselves surrounded by a ring of ducks, all quacking nonstop.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack... Sinner Hecate detected. Initiating detention.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the... Why are they coming after Sinners even in Project: Dark?! And why are you their first target again?!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stories often take inspiration from reality and surpass reality.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack... All unauthorized individuals, please stand back. Do not interfere with law enforcement!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! I'm a Sinner too! I'm not just some unauthorized individual!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You just avoided my eyes, didn't you? Do you think I'm not good enough to be a Sinner?
Seeing the duck avert its eyes, Hella's grip around the pipe tightens.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack quack! Proceed with detention! Ignore this chatterbox—she can't even make it out of the detention room! Quack!

People sometimes appear unusually calm before they erupt in anger. 
Uncharacteristically, Hella turns to Hecate and asks a question—this time, with surprising patience.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So... we can do anything we want here, right? After all, this is just a <color=#fb9259>Hologram</color>, right?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's correct.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! I'm gonna give these ******* ducks a hundred bumps on their heads!
